statement: ∀ j : ℕ, 598≤j → j≤1049 → let n : ℕ := 2^j; ∃ p q : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ q.Prime ∧ p+q=n

plain_statement.en: New route · V14 · Certify the prime pairs at dyadic endpoints with exponents 598 through 1049
